overview: Bilingual English/Bengali e-commerce bookshop with a Study Materials section for engineering question papers organized by department, year, semester, subject, regulation, and class test.
features: Browse and buy books with dark navy/orange theme
Study Materials section with cascading filters for department, year, semester, subject, regulation, and class test
Admin panel to upload and manage PDF question papers
Sample question paper entries across CSE, ECE, EE, ME, CE departments with R-23 and R-25 regulations
